outlook.statement: Primary objective will be to build a strong and quality order book for the upcoming years, which will provide the foundation for sustainable growth. Company will continue to manage its cash flows in an efficient manner and remain steadfast in its endeavour to increase the value of all its stakeholders.
Company is also adopting the vast implementation and use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in all business segments including project estimation, monitoring or contract management.
Indian infrastructure is growing on a fast pace and in upcoming years there can be the most high-speed development in the industry which can be sensed from the recent budget of the nation.

The management represents that the Company holds investments in 2 Toll Road Projects. The liquidity position of the Company is improving on account of conclusion of stake sale/harmonious substitution of the Subsidiaries till the period ended March 31, 2026. Further on the basis of cashflow projections considering monetisation of assets, realisation of claims and cost control measures, the Company will be able to repay or settle its liabilities as and when they fall due.

qualifications_or_emphasis: Standalone: Unable to comment on appropriateness of carrying value of investments (including subordinate debt), loans and advances, trade and other receivables related to RPTPL and RHTPL aggregating INR 8,043.91 million as at March 31, 2026.

Consolidated: 1) Interest on deferred premium obligation and borrowings not accounted in RPTPL and RHTPL, resulting in understatement of finance cost and losses (amount unascertained); financial statements prepared on non-going concern basis. 2) Material uncertainty on going concern for Sadbhav Jodhpur Ring Road Private Limited (tax credit receivable INR 152.15 million). 3) Material uncertainty on going concern for Sadbhav Bangalore Highway Private Limited (tax credit receivable INR 420.68 million). 4) Material uncertainty on going concern for Sadbhav Vidarbha Highway Limited (tax credit receivable INR 503.45 million). 5) Realisability of GST input tax credit receivable INR 118.64 million in Sadbhav Nainital Highway Limited. 6) Material uncertainty on going concern for Sadbhav Udaipur Highway Limited due to endorsement agreement for substitution of concessionaire and no alternative business plans.
Non-compliance with Regulation 17(1)(c) of SEBI LODR: Board had only five directors against minimum six after Mr. Jatin Thakkar's cessation on 30-09-2025
Non-compliance with Regulation 31 of SEBI LODR: Delay of 4 days in filing shareholding pattern for quarter ended 30th June 2025
Non-compliance with Regulation 6(1) of SEBI LODR: Delay of 184 days in appointing Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
Modified opinion on audited financial results (standalone and consolidated) for quarter and year ended 31st March 2026

Basis for Qualified Opinion: Unable to corroborate management's contention of realising the carrying value of investments (including subordinate debt), loans and advances, trade and other receivables related to Rohtak Panipat Tollway Private Limited and Rohtak Hissar Tollway Private Limited aggregating to INR 8,043.91 million as at March 31, 2026.

Emphasis of Matter: Balances in the accounts of parties pertaining to trade payables and other incidental balances thereto, are currently under evaluation by the management. Subsequent adjustments, if any, may be necessary upon completion of this evaluation and reconciliation.

Material uncertainty related to going concern: The Company's financial position and financial performance for the year ended March 31, 2026 on account of significant reduction in revenue and substantial losses over period indicate that a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

Matters described in the Basis for Qualified Opinion paragraph and the going concern matter described in Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern paragraph may have an adverse effect on the functioning of the Company
Qualified opinion on the operating effectiveness of the Company's internal financial controls with reference to Standalone Financial Statements

Material uncertainty exists as on the date of the audit report indicating that the Company is not capable of meeting its liabilities existing at the date of balance sheet as and when they fall due within a period of one year from the balance sheet date

Basis for Qualified Opinion: Sadbhav Udaipur Highway Limited (SUDHL) - material uncertainty on going concern due to harmonious substitution proceedings and lack of alternate audit evidence; qualified opinion expressed by SUDHL auditors for FY2026 & FY2025.

Basis for Qualified Opinion: Sadbhav Jodhpur Ring Road Private Limited (SJRRPL) - GST credit receivables of INR 152.15 Million (Mar 31, 2026) and INR 152.12 Million (Mar 31, 2025) with no business activity and no management plan for utilization; qualified opinion expressed by auditors for FY2026 & FY2025.

Basis for Qualified Opinion: Sadbhav Bangalore Highway Private Limited (SBGHPL) - GST credit receivables of INR 420.68 Million (Mar 31, 2026) and INR 420.65 Million (Mar 31, 2025) with no business activity and no management plan; qualified opinion expressed by SBGHPL auditors for FY2026 & FY2025.

Basis for Qualified Opinion: Sadbhav Vidarbha Highway Limited (SVHL) - GST credit receivables of INR 503.45 Million (Mar 31, 2026) and INR 504.71 Million (Mar 31, 2025) with no business activity and no management plan; qualified opinion expressed by SVHL auditors for FY2026 & FY2025.

Basis for Qualified Opinion: Sadbhav Nainital Highway Limited (SNHL) - GST credit receivables of INR 118.64 Million (Mar 31, 2026) and INR 118.57 Million (Mar 31, 2025) with no business activity and no management plan; qualified opinion expressed by SNHL auditors for FY2026 & FY2025.

Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: Group's accumulated losses exceed paid-up capital and reserves by INR 6,184.88 Million; current liabilities exceed current assets by INR 8,585.76 Million; difficulty in meeting obligations to lenders, suppliers, statutory dues; some subsidiaries' accounts classified as NPAs.

Emphasis of Matter a: Rohtak Panipat Tollway Private Limited (RPTPL) and Rohtak Hissar Tollway Private Limited (RHTPL) - financial statements prepared on non-going concern basis due to termination notice to NHAI; adjustments include transfer of intangible assets to claims receivable, derecognition of major maintenance and premium obligations; lenders filed recovery case before DRT Ahmedabad and assigned debt to NARCL; arbitration awards under challenge at Delhi High Court.

Emphasis of Matter b: Maharashtra Border Check Post Network Limited (MBCPNL) - Intangible Asset/Intangible Assets under Development of INR 2,228.84 million accounted based on lenders' engineer and technical experts' recommendation; pending final approval by Government of Maharashtra.
Emphasis of Matter c: MBCPNL - termination notice issued by Government of Maharashtra contested by MBCPNL; management confident of favourable resolution.
Emphasis of Matter d: MBCPNL - disruption in Fastag services across 23 Border Check Posts due to malicious cyber-attack on September 14, 2025; manual processes implemented for revenue continuity.

Emphasis of Matter e: MBCPNL - pending adjustments of outstanding balances relating to legacy transactions pursuant to share purchase agreement dated August 16, 2021 between Adani Road Transport Limited (ARTL) and Sadbhav Infrastructure Project Limited (SIPL).

Emphasis of Matter f: Sadbhav Nainital Highway Limited (SNHL) - endorsement agreement dated July 14, 2023 and definitive agreement dated August 01, 2023 for harmonious substitution in favour of new concessionaire for INR 900 million; financial statements prepared on non-going concern basis.

Emphasis of Matter g: Sadbhav Rudrapur Highway Limited (SRHL) - endorsement agreement dated February 09, 2026 with NHAI approval for substitution by new concessionaire; financial statements prepared on non-going concern basis.
Emphasis of Matter h: Sadbhav Kim Expressway Private Limited (SKEPL) - exceptional loss of INR 398.27 million recognized from sale of business undertaking on slump sale basis.

Emphasis of Matter i: Sadbhav Hybrid Annuity Projects Limited (SHAPL) - corporate guarantee invoked by debenture holders of Holding Company; insolvency application filed against SHAPL pending before NCLT New Delhi; outcome uncertain, no adjustments made.
Emphasis of Matter j: Sadbhav Bangalore Highway Private Limited (SBGHPL) - application filed by State Bank of India & Bank of India for recovery of outstanding amount, challenged by subsidiary.
Emphasis of Matter k: Vendors claimed additional amounts on account of interest etc., contested by Holding Company; management considers claims not tenable and no provision required.
Internal Financial Controls: Qualified opinion on operating effectiveness of Group's internal financial controls with reference to Consolidated Financial Statements.

Audit Trail: Holding Company and 13 subsidiaries - audit trail feature not available at database level to log direct data changes to certain non-editable fields/tables; MBCPNL - statutory auditor unable to comment whether audit trail feature was enabled and operated for direct changes to database from May 27, 2025 to December 12, 2025.

Material weakness in internal financial control system towards estimating the carrying value of assets and liabilities of subsidiary companies as explained in Note 48, 49, 52 (iii), 53, 54, 55 and 56 to the accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements were not operating effectively which could potentially lead to non adjustments, if any, that may be required to the carrying values of assets and liabilities of subsidiary Companies and its consequential impact on financial performance and financial position in the Consolidated Financial Statements.

The Holding Company internal process and based on the reports of other auditors of the subsidiary Companies there exists material weaknesses in operating effectiveness over system processing invoices and obtaining balance confirmation from vendors and processing of journal entries into accounting software due to absence of maker checker mechanism which could result into possible adjustments of transactions / balances.
Qualified opinion on RPTPL financial statements - non-going concern basis, interest not accounted on NPA borrowings, carrying value of Receivable from NHAI
Qualified opinion on RHTPL financial statements - non-going concern basis, interest not accounted on NPA borrowings
Qualified opinion on SUDHL financial statements - harmonious substitution conditions precedent
Qualified opinion on SRHL financial statements - harmonious substitution execution
Qualified opinion on SKEPL financial statements - material uncertainty related to going concern
Qualified opinion on SJRRPL, SBGHPL, SNHL, SVHL financial statements - going concern basis with unutilized GST credits/losses

The Group uses an accounting software for maintaining its books of account which has a feature of recording audit trail (edit log) facility and the same has operated throughout the year for all relevant transactions recorded in the accounting software. However, the audit trail feature is not available for certain direct changes to database for certain non editable fields/ tables of the accounting software. Further no instance of audit trail feature being tampered with was noted in respect of the accounting software. Additionally, the audit trail has been preserved by the Group as per the statutory requirements for record retention.

As at March 31, 2026 Group's accumulated losses exceeded paid up capital by INR (6,184.88) millions. Further some of the subsidiary Companies finds difficulty in meeting obligations of the lenders and accounts of some of the subsidiary companies have been classified as NPA by the lenders. Debenture Holders of the Company has initiated legal action against the company demanding payment pursuant to Directed redemption notice. The actual redemption of series B of Debenture is scheduled in July, 2026. The Company is in the process of taking necessary remedial measure in the matter. These factors raise concern about Group's ability to continue as going concern.

Operational Environment: Technological advancements, exposure to market risks, and intensifying competitive dynamics within the infrastructure sector.

Asset-Specific Provisions: The potential expiration or termination of concession agreements relating to specific project Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs), general developments within the transport sector, traffic volume fluctuations, and evolving governmental policies impacting the transportation industry in India.

Delays due to disputes, rehabilitation concerns, and lengthy approval processes increase project costs and timelines.
Bureaucratic hurdles, litigation, and coordination problems among multiple agencies often slow project execution.
Extreme weather events, floods, cyclones, and heatwaves pose increasing risks to infrastructure resilience which also affects the timely completion and delivery of project.
Traffic and revenue underperformance, Construction disputes, Delayed annuity payments, Land acquisition issues, Refinancing pressure, Concession-related dispute.

orders_or_contracts.statement: SNHL executed Endorsement Agreement dated July 14, 2023 with the approval of NHAI for harmonious substitution of the SNHL as Concessionaire in favour of new Concessionaire for implementation of the project and also entered into Definitive Agreement on August 01, 2023. In terms of these agreements the project and project assets as defined in the Concession Agreement along with the relevant rights and obligations of SNHL are transferred to the new Concessionaire for substitution of the SNHL in consideration of INR 900 Millions.
